import { useState } from 'react'; import FadeIn from './FadeIn'; export default function Contact() { const [status,setStatus]=useState(''); const submit=async(e)=>{e.preventDefault(); const form=new FormData(e.target); if(!form.get('name')||!form.get('email')||!form.get('message')) return setStatus('Please complete all fields.'); if('YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY' === form.get('access_key')) return setStatus('Add your Web3Forms access key in Contact.jsx to enable sending.'); setStatus('Sending…'); try { const r=await fetch('https://api.web3forms.com/submit',{method:'POST',body:form}); setStatus((await r.json()).success?'Thank you — your message has been sent.':'Something went wrong. Please try again.'); } catch { setStatus('Could not send right now. Please email me directly.'); }}; return
